1 import SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralFans
2 
3 /-! The seven retained hinges of the eight-triangle fan-and-petal development. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralNet
6 
7 open OctahedralTriangles
8 
9 /-- `false` names a fan triangle; `true` names its attached petal. -/
10 abbrev FaceIndex := Bool × Fin 4
11 
12 /-- Three consecutive fan hinges and four fan-to-petal hinges. -/
13 def hinges : SimpleGraph FaceIndex where
14   Adj x y :=
15     (x.1 = false ∧ y.1 = false ∧ (x.2.val + 1 = y.2.val ∨ y.2.val + 1 = x.2.val)) ∨
16     (x.1 ≠ y.1 ∧ x.2 = y.2)
17   symm := by
18     rintro x y (⟨hx, hy, before | after⟩ | ⟨opposite, same⟩)
19     · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hx, Or.inr before⟩
20     · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hx, Or.inl after⟩
21     · exact Or.inr ⟨opposite.symm, same.symm⟩
22   loopless := ⟨by
23     intro x adjacent
24     rcases adjacent with ⟨_, _, bad⟩ | ⟨bad, _⟩
25     · omega
26     · exact bad rfl⟩
27 
28 instance : DecidableRel hinges.Adj := by unfold hinges; infer_instance
29 
30 theorem connected : hinges.Connected := by
31   rw [SimpleGraph.connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
32   refine ⟨(false, 0), ?_⟩
33   have step01 : hinges.Adj (false, 0) (false, 1) := by decide
34   have step12 : hinges.Adj (false, 1) (false, 2) := by decide
35   have step23 : hinges.Adj (false, 2) (false, 3) := by decide
36   have fan_reachable (i : Fin 4) : hinges.Reachable (false, 0) (false, i) := by
37     fin_cases i
38     · exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
39     · exact step01.reachable
40     · exact step01.reachable.trans step12.reachable
41     · exact (step01.reachable.trans step12.reachable).trans step23.reachable
42   rintro ⟨petal, i⟩
43   cases petal
44   · exact fan_reachable i
45   · exact (fan_reachable i).trans ((show hinges.Adj (false, i) (true, i) from Or.inr ⟨by change false ≠ true; decide, rfl⟩).reachable)
46 
47 /-- The prescribed seven hinges form a tree on all eight triangles. -/
48 theorem isTree : hinges.IsTree := by
49   rw [SimpleGraph.isTree_iff_connected_and_card]
50   refine ⟨connected, ?_⟩
51   rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
52   decide
53 
54 /-- The underlying original subdivision triangle at each position in the opening. -/
55 def triangle (source : Fin 6) (slit : Fin 4) (index : FaceIndex) : Fin 8 :=
56   if index.1 then fanTriangle source (slit + index.2) else fanTriangle (opposite source) (slit + index.2)
57 
58 theorem triangle_bijective : ∀ source slit, Function.Bijective (triangle source slit) := by decide
59 
60 theorem vertices_injective : Function.Injective OctahedralTriangles.vertices := by decide
61 
62 theorem octahedron_carrier : ∀ t, carrier .octahedron t = OctahedralTriangles.vertices t := by decide
63 
64 /-- Every retained hinge is one of the seven construction steps, in one of its two directions. -/
65 theorem hinge_cases : ∀ x y, hinges.Adj x y →
66     (∃ i : Fin 3, x = (false, i.castSucc) ∧ y = (false, i.succ)) ∨
67     (∃ i : Fin 3, y = (false, i.castSucc) ∧ x = (false, i.succ)) ∨
68     (∃ i : Fin 4, x = (false, i) ∧ y = (true, i)) ∨
69     (∃ i : Fin 4, y = (false, i) ∧ x = (true, i)) := by decide
70 
71 /-- Consecutive fan triangles share precisely the indicated pole-to-equator pair. -/
72 theorem fan_common_vertices : ∀ source slit (i : Fin 3),
73     OctahedralTriangles.vertices (triangle source slit (false, i.castSucc)) ∩
74       OctahedralTriangles.vertices (triangle source slit (false, i.succ)) =
75         {opposite source, fanNeighbor (opposite source) ((slit + i.castSucc) + 1)} := by decide
76 
77 /-- A fan triangle and its petal share precisely their equator pair. -/
78 theorem petal_common_vertices : ∀ source slit i,
79     OctahedralTriangles.vertices (triangle source slit (false, i)) ∩
80       OctahedralTriangles.vertices (triangle source slit (true, i)) =
81         {fanNeighbor source (slit + i), fanNeighbor source ((slit + i) + 1)} := by decide
82 
83 /-- All seven retained hinges have exactly two common distinct original vertex labels. -/
84 theorem hinge_common_card : ∀ source slit x y, hinges.Adj x y →
85     (OctahedralTriangles.vertices (triangle source slit x) ∩
86       OctahedralTriangles.vertices (triangle source slit y)).card = 2 := by decide
87 
88 end SixVertexUnfolding.OctahedralNet
